title: When Does More Correct Data Hurt? Insertion-Stability and the Limits of Dimension-Based Theory
abstract: arXiv:2608.14020v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Adding data known to be correct ought to be safe. Not always. Larsen, Pabbaraju and Shetty model the failure with a monotone adversary, which reads an i.i.d. training sample and may append as many further examples as it likes, provided the target hypothesis labels them all. Mehrotra has since settled the cost, showing that for classes of VC dimension d >= 2 no learner can guarantee expected error better than Theta((d/n)log(en/d)), a logarithmic factor above the clean PAC rate.   Because that rate is a worst case over all classes, it says nothing about which classes actually suffer the penalty, and the answer turns on the learner. We call a learner insertion-stable if feeding it more correctly labeled examples can only shrink the region where it errs. Such learners are immune to the adversary, since on any given sample the risk after insertions never exceeds the risk on the clean part alone, however much is added and however cleverly it i

translated_title: 何时更多正确的数据反而有害？插入稳定性与基于维度理论的局限性
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.14020v1 公告类型：新公告 摘要：添加已知正确的数据本应是安全的，但并非总是如此。Larsen、Pabbaraju和Shetty用单调对手模型化了这一失败现象，该对手读取独立同分布的训练样本，并可以随意附加更多示例，前提是目标假设对所有示例都进行标注。Mehrotra随后解决了成本问题，表明对于VC维度d >= 2的类别，任何学习器都无法保证期望误差优于Theta((d/n)log(en/d))，这比干净的PAC率高出一个对数因子。由于该率是所有类别的最坏情况，它并未说明哪些类别实际上会遭受惩罚，而答案取决于学习器。我们称一个学习器为插入稳定的，如果向其提供更多正确标注的示例只会缩小其出错的区域。此类学习器对对手免疫，因为在任何给定样本上，插入后的风险永远不会超过仅干净部分的风险，无论添加多少数据以及如何巧妙地添加。
tldr: 本文提出“插入稳定性”概念，揭示并非所有学习器都会因额外正确数据而受损，只有非插入稳定的学习器才会面临对数因子代价，从而填补了维度理论在最坏情况分析中的空白。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the concept of "insertion-stability," showing that not all learners suffer from additional correct data, and only non-insertion-stable learners face a logarithmic penalty, thus filling a gap in dimension-based worst-case analysis.
